tools.name: search_shop_products
tools.description: Browse equipment ideas in one of BeachFinder's ten categories. Normal BeachFinder tools already include one contextual Shop suggestion, so do not call this tool just to duplicate it. Returns original packing suggestions and a link to the matching Shop selection, not individual merchant offers, photo
